results.title: Playback Subscriptions | Explained
results.summary: Separates Playback Features (Intro, Premium, Cloud Pro, Live Bundle), Playback Content (Rentals, purchased tracks, Sounds, uploaded Cloud Songs, click and guide), and Playback Access (Team Sharing seats). Playback Intro is free on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS but limited to a single stereo output and excludes Premium features (editing arrangements, Playback Remote, Playback Sync). Cloud Pro adds click and guide for every song, Team Sharing seats, and saved custom-named arrangements; uploading Cloud Songs requires Cloud Pro. Rentals are device-specific and not shared. The article does not explain how to check or manage the subscription in-app.

results.title: GET STARTED | Cloud Pro Subscription
results.summary: What Cloud Pro gates for Playback: click and guide tracks for every catalog song in setlists (with key/tempo/arrangement edits persisting when tracks are later purchased or rented), saved Custom Arrangements (fader mix, key/tempo, sections), Cloud Songs with uploaded stems/charts/MIDI, custom click and guide cues, cloud-saved MIDI Cues, editing cloud sections, and 10 Playback Team Sharing licenses. Storage 'starts at 50GB' per this article (the pricing page lists other tiers). Cloud Pro also removes the 48-hour download expiration on purchased downloads. No activation or sign-in steps are given.

results.title: Playback FAQs
results.summary: The help center's Playback FAQ article has two questions. (1) How do I get song content for Playback: five documented ways: Playback Rentals (recommended, cheapest for weekly use), purchasing Artist Original Master Track products on MultiTracks.com (buy once, stays available for your location; extra licenses for additional campuses), uploading your own content with Cloud Pro (multitracks or single-file backing tracks, then add click, guide and song sections), using just the Click & Guide for any catalog song (requires Cloud Pro, Live Bundle, or Playback Rentals), and Sounds content (ambient pads and Soundbeds purchased on MultiTracks.com appear in Playback for free). (2) Does Playback show lyrics or chords: No. Playback is audio-first and does not display lyrics or charts.

steps.text: To get songs: unlock a Playback Rental, buy the track product on MultiTracks.com, upload your own content with Cloud Pro, use Click & Guide only (Cloud Pro, Live Bundle, or Rentals), or use purchased Sounds pads and Soundbeds.
Playback does not display lyrics or chord charts; it is audio-first. (ChartBuilder is MultiTracks' charts product; charts are out of Playback support scope.)

results.sectionPath: Playback User Guide > Live Performance > Waveform: Navigating the Song
results.text:
Use the waveform to navigate the currently playing song in real time. Here are some powerful tools and actions to use while a song is playing.

- Live ReOrder (Pro feature): Scroll the waveform while the song is playing to locate another song section. Double tap the song section bubble, and Playback jump to it mid-song as soon as the currently playing section ends.
- Enable Section Loop (Pro feature): Tap the Loop icon in the top right of any song section to cue that section for a Single Loop. Once Playback comes to the end of a loop-enabled section, it will begin replaying.

steps.text: Live ReOrder (Pro feature): Scroll the waveform while the song is playing to locate another song section. Double tap the song section bubble, and Playback jump to it mid-song as soon as the currently playing section ends.

Enable Section Loop (Pro feature): Tap the Loop icon in the top right of any song section to cue that section for a Single Loop. Once Playback comes to the end of a loop-enabled section, it will begin replaying.

results.text:
If you are logging into your own organization, then you are ready to start downloading your organization’s purchased content or Rental credits immediately. When logging into another organization, certain permission subscriptions need to be added to your account in order for you to access purchased tracks, spend Rental credits, or save Cloud changes to setlists, song arrangements, and MIDI Cues.

For more information about managing your organization’s team members, subscriptions, and content permissions, check out: 📖 Managing Roles and Permissions

Once logged in, you’re ready to start building a setlist!
